text_post: Need Some Text Help - Go Booty Call or Date? I met a french girl at the bar last thursday. The night i met her i tried to get her back to my place with a late night "come over to my place for a drink" text & she responded with a "too late. next time". I assume had i texted her earlier that night when i got home maybe i could've gotten the same night lay. She doesn't respond to phone calls and her english isn't so good but she's been consistently texting back & forth with me for the past couple days since we met.  On monday I invite her out for a drink with a "I'm going out to Bar "x" tonight u should come meet me for a drink" Half hour later she responds: "Hey my dear!Tks, it would be with pleasure but i have yoga 2nite till 9.Then back house, shower...should be to late to join u.Wednesday nite??" I don't respond to her text until the next evening (tuesday) when i send out: "Sounds good i'll let u know". Its wednesday now. should i invite her out today like she suggested? don't text her at all today? or should i just re-frame the situation with a "sorry im going to have to cancel on you tonight" text and challenge her a bit?  My instinct tells me i should just forget the whole date thing and wait until the weekend and go for a straight booty call "hey whatsup" text when shes drunk...cuz it almost worked the first night i met her. Any ideas?
